How it works

What to expect in your detail.

Friendly technicians. Premium products. Your driveway.

1. Arrive

We pull up with our own water and power, so there is nothing to hook up. You stay home, at work, or wherever your day takes you.

2. Detail

We work zone by zone: vacuum, wipe down, shampoo and shine, with premium products and techniques for a professional finish.

3. Walk through

We check the finished car with you. If we miss anything, we come back and fix it for free.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions.

Everything you need to know before booking your first detail.

What is Revived Detail?

Revived is a mobile auto detailing business based in Tulsa, Oklahoma. We come to your home, apartment, or office to provide professional interior and exterior detailing — no shop visit required.

How do I book an appointment?

Use the quote form on our Contact page, or call or text us directly at 918-200-9554. Tell us where you are and what your car needs, and we'll follow up with next steps.

Where do you detail the car? Can you come to apartments or parking garages?

We detail wherever your car is parked — driveways, apartment complexes, office lots, and parking garages. If you're in a gated community or garage, just let us know the access details when you book.

Are your technicians licensed and insured?

Yes — Revived is licensed and insured, and we stand behind every detail we do.

What if I'm not satisfied with the results?

We're human, and accidents happen. If anything doesn't meet your expectations, let us know and we'll come back and fix it — free of charge.

Do I need a service plan, or can I book one-time?

Service plans are optional. You're welcome to book a one-time Interior or Full Detail any time — but Revived Care Plan members save $60–$100 per visit with Quarterly, Bi-Monthly, or Monthly scheduling.

What areas do you serve?

We're based in Tulsa and serve the greater Tulsa metro, including Broken Arrow, Bixby, Jenks, Owasso, Sand Springs, Sapulpa, Glenpool, Coweta, Catoosa, Claremore, Collinsville, and Skiatook. Not sure if we reach you? Just ask.

Meet the Team

Nathan Hoffman
& Cruz Williamson.

Two college roommates who decided Tulsa deserved a better detailing company.

Nathan and Cruz were college roommates and friends long before they were business partners. Late nights, big ideas, and one question that kept coming up: what are we actually going to build?

Nathan had been detailing cars since high school. Cruz had worked at a car wash. They came at it from different angles, but they both saw the same gap in the market, one nobody was taking seriously. So they decided to fill it.

They didn’t set out to start a mobile detailing company. They set out to fix an industry, because here is what they kept running into:

  1. Sketchy vans pulling up to detail $80,000 vehicles.
  2. Weak branding that never earned your trust.
  3. Customer service that felt like an afterthought.
  4. Four-hour time windows, and sometimes no one showing up at all.

The home services industry had a reputation problem, and nobody was fixing it.

So they did.

Revived was built to change what people expect when a service shows up at their door: a white-glove experience, professional technicians, and a company that genuinely cares about your car and your time. Nathan and Cruz aren’t just running a detailing business. They’re setting a new standard for mobile service in Tulsa, and eventually, across the nation.
